L'organisation R&D de CSL accélère l'innovation afin d'avoir un plus grand impact pour les patients. Grâce à une structure dirigée par projet et en mettant l’accent sur la collaboration, nous construisons une équipe prête pour l’avenir qui prospère dans des écosystèmes biotechnologiques dynamiques. Rejoindre CSL, c’est désormais faire partie d’une équipe agile engagée à développer des thérapies qui font une différence significative dans le monde entier. Pourriez-vous être notre prochain directeur principal, recherche et évaluation, responsable AT tardif, immunologie ? Le poste se déroule dans nos bureaux de Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Suisse ou Maidenhead UK. Il s'agit d'un poste hybride et est sur place trois jours par semaine. Résumé de la description du poste Les directeurs principaux de la recherche et de l'évaluation dirigeront l'approvisionnement stratégique et l'évaluation du domaine thérapeutique externe de l'hématologie à un stade ultérieur. Vous vous concentrerez sur les opportunités de la phase 2 jusqu'aux médicaments commercialisés, nécessitant une expertise clinique approfondie, un engagement fort avec les principaux leaders d'opinion (KOL) externes et les enquêteurs cliniques, ainsi qu'une compréhension approfondie de l'évolution des normes de soins. Ce rôle est essentiel pour façonner notre portefeuille grâce à des partenariats et des transactions à fort impact. ​ Principales responsabilités et responsabilités ​
• Servir de leader senior en S&E au sein du TALT, en influençant la stratégie thérapeutique et en intégrant les priorités d'innovation externe à un stade avancé dans la planification du portefeuille. ​
• Diriger les efforts d'approvisionnement proactifs pour la phase 2 vers les actifs commercialisés, en identifiant les opportunités qui correspondent à la stratégie d'AT et aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits. ​
• Codiriger des réunions internes (avec le responsable de la recherche précoce) axées sur l'évaluation et la priorisation des opportunités de nouveaux produits (OBNL) dans les domaines thérapeutiques de chaque CSL. Les réunions des NPO sont des points de contrôle stratégiques où les équipes interfonctionnelles examinent les actifs potentiels identifiés par Search et décident de les faire avancer pour une diligence raisonnable plus approfondie et des négociations commerciales.
• S'engager largement avec des KOL externes, des enquêteurs cliniques et des réseaux pour valider le potentiel des actifs, comprendre les conceptions d'essais et les paramètres cliniques et anticiper la dynamique concurrentielle. ​
• Maintenir une connaissance approfondie de l'évolution des normes de soins et des paysages concurrentiels pour éclairer les priorités d'approvisionnement et la stratégie de transaction. ​
• Mener une diligence raisonnable interfonctionnelle pour les actifs en phase de développement avancé, en coordonnant les évaluations cliniques, réglementaires, commerciales et d'accès au marché pour soutenir les décisions de gouvernance. ​
• Collaborer étroitement avec le BD et les responsables régionaux de l'écosystème pour faire progresser les opportunités hautement prioritaires grâce à la négociation et à la conclusion d'accords, garantissant un transfert et une exécution fluides. ​
• Représenter le TA à l'externe, diriger les activités d'approvisionnement lors de conférences spécialisées et établir des relations avec les communautés pharmaceutique, biotechnologique et clinique. ​ Exigences de qualifications et d'expérience ​
• Plus de 15 ans dans le domaine biopharmaceutique avec une expérience significative en développement clinique, en innovation externe ou en développement commercial. ​
• Diplôme d'études supérieures requis (MD, PhD ou équivalent). ​
• Expertise clinique approfondie dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de l'hématologie ou des maladies cardiovasculaires/rénales. ​

Job Description
Responsibilities:

• Plan, support, and monitor regulatory affairs activities related to plasma derived medicinal products and human plasma as starting material to ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements and support current and future business activities.

• Support the preparation, review, and maintenance of regulatory documentation for Plasma Master Files (PMFs), plasma source registrations, and related submissions for the European Union, Switzerland, and international markets.

• Support preparation and submission of regulatory applications, variations, renewals, responses to health authority questions, and other regulatory filings related to plasma and biologic products.

• Contribute to the assessment and implementation of regulatory requirements, guidelines, and emerging regulations impacting plasma derived products, plasma collection, and related manufacturing processes.

• Support regulatory activities associated with plasma source lifecycle management, including new plasma source registrations, maintenance activities, and change control assessments.

• Collaborate with cross functional teams to support regulatory strategy development, change management activities, technical assessments, and regulatory risk evaluations.

• Support interactions with global regulatory authorities and contribute to the preparation of health authority communications, briefing materials, and scientific or regulatory discussions.

• Support regulatory activities associated with U.S. plasma center licensing and maintenance activities, including coordination of documentation and support for regulatory inspections and submissions.

• Contribute to scientific and technical regulatory evaluations related to plasma collection, plasma manufacturing processes, and biologic product lifecycle management.

• Monitor regulatory developments and advise management and project teams on the potential impact of new or changing regulations on business activities and regulatory strategies.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, regulatory agencies, and external partners.

• Support development of consistent roles, work processes, regulatory procedures, and documentation practices across global regulatory activities.

• Regulatory system data entry, maintenance, and management of regulatory information and documentation within applicable systems.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor degree in a Life Science or related scientific discipline required. Advanced degree in a Life Science (PhD, MD) or Regulatory Affairs related field an advantage.

• 3+ years regulatory experience in the pharmaceutical, biologics, or biotechnology industry. Experience with biologics, plasma derived medicinal products, or blood/plasma related regulations preferred.

• Experience supporting global regulatory submissions and interactions with regulatory authorities preferred.

• Strong scientific, analytical, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a global environment.

• Ability to work collaboratively across functions and contribute to complex regulatory and technical discussions.

• Contribuire alle valutazioni scientifiche e tecniche relative alla raccolta del plasma, ai processi di produzione del plasma e alla gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti biologici.

• Stabilire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro efficaci con gli stakeholder interni, le agenzie di regolamentazione e i partner esterni.
• Sostenere lo sviluppo di ruoli coerenti, processi di lavoro, procedure regolamentari e pratiche di documentazione in tutte le attività normative globali.
• Registrazione, manutenzione e gestione dei dati del sistema regolamentare all'interno dei sistemi applicabili. Qualifiche:
• Laurea in una scienza della vita o disciplina scientifica correlata necessaria. Laurea avanzata in una scienza della vita (PhD, MD) o affari regolamentari relativi campo un vantaggio.

jobs.title: Director, Analytical Strategy
jobs.description:
The Analytical Strategy Director is a key scientific and strategic leadership role. In this position you will be responsible for developing and driving analytical strategies that support drug discovery, development, and regulatory approval. The position ensures the implementation of robust, compliant, and innovative analytical approaches across preclinical and clinical development programs, as well as throughout product life cycle management (LCM).

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

Strategic Leadership​

• Develop and lead the global analytical strategy aligned with program and corporate goals​

• Provide scientific and regulatory guidance for analytical plans across all development phases (discovery → post-marketing)​

• Drive innovation in analytical technologies, platforms, and workflows​

• Represent analytical function in cross-functional governance and decision-making forums​

Scientific Oversight​

• Oversee development, validation, and implementation of analytical methods (e.g., LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, immunogenicity)​

• Ensure high-quality data generation for PK, PD, biomarker, and immunogenicity studies​

• Review and approve analytical study designs, reports, and regulatory documentation​

• Troubleshoot complex scientific and technical challenges​

Regulatory & Compliance​

• Ensure compliance with global regulatory guidelines (FDA, EMA, ICH, GLP, GCP)​

• Lead analytical sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA, MAA)​

• Interface with regulatory agencies and respond to health authority queries​

• Maintain inspection readiness and quality standards​

Cross-Functional Collaboration​

• Partner with Clinical Pharmacology, DMPK, Toxicology, Biomarkers, and Clinical Operations​

• Support translational strategy and dose selection decisions​

• Manage external CROs, academic collaborators, and technology vendors​

Leadership & Management​

• Lead and mentor analytical scientists and project leaders​

• Manage budgets, timelines, and resource allocation​

• Build and scale analytical capabilities and infrastructure​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements​

• PhD in analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or related field (or MSc with extensive experience)​

• Typically 12–15+ years in bioanalysis within biotech, pharma, or CRO environments​

• Deep expertise in LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, and immunogenicity testing​

• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements and analytical validation standards​

• Proven leadership and strategic program experience​

• Experience supporting regulatory submissions and health authority interactions​

Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

jobs.description:
The Director Non-Clinical Due Diligence & External Evaluations provides scientific leadership for nonclinical due diligence supporting CSL’s in‑licensing, acquisitions, and strategic collaborations. The role ensures integrated, objective, and decision‑relevant evaluations of nonclinical pharmacology, PK/QSP, and toxicology data to identify development risks, data gaps, and mitigation strategies and to inform portfolio decisions.
The incumbent will further act as nonclinical representative for selected Research programs and support oversight of nonclinical strategies and programs across all Therapeutic Areas.

The role reports to the Executive Director, Head of Nonclinical Development.

Responsibilities and accountabilities

• Leads operational execution of nonclinical due diligence for assigned opportunities.

• Acts as hands‑on scientific integrator, translating expert input into clear risk narratives.

• Trusted subject‑matter lead for nonclinical DD on individual deals.

• Lead end-to-end nonclinical due diligence for individual assets or transactions, from request through final governance readout.

• Integrate input from Toxicology, PK/QSP, Nonclinical Pharmacology, and external experts into a single, coherent scientific assessment.

• Identify FIH‑enabling gaps, translational risks, and regulatory limitations, with clear mitigation proposals.

• Prepare high‑quality DD reports, executive summaries, and risk tables for governance review.

• Act as NCD scientific interface to Business Development and Therapeutic Area teams at the project level.

• Contribute to maintenance and continuous improvement of nonclinical DD frameworks and templates.

• Mentor junior contributors and matrix team members as appropriate.

• Escalates complex or high‑impact issues to Head of NCD

• Chair of “NCD Review Committee”

Qualifications:
Education:

• Advanced degree (Ph.D., D.V.M., or equivalent) in toxicology, pharmacology, or a related field

• Toxicology training, board certification preferred

Experience :

• Experience in nonclinical development (10+ years) with proven experience in due diligence or external innovation, ideally across various geographies.

• Strong understanding of FIH‑enabling nonclinical requirements, particularly for biologics and complex modalities.

• Ability to communicate complex scientific risk clearly to non‑expert stakeholders.

• Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities is highly desirable.

Competencies:

• Proven ability to work effectively both independently or in a team setting, and to meet set goals by managing own timelines.

• Experience in working in cross-functional, multicultural and international teams.

• Excellent communication and analytical skills.

• Experience in analyzing and presenting research results to scientific and professional audiences.

• Strong planning and organizational skills.

• Ability to work successfully in a matrix organizational structure.

• Strong negotiation skills and ability to identify and engage internal and external expertise as needed.

• Good understanding of drug development process, strong knowledge of ICH/GLP

• Fluent in English, oral and written;

The role requires onsite presence 3 days per week.
The role can be based in Zurich, Switzerland or Waltham, USA.

• Führen Sie die operative Durchführung von nichtklinischen Due Diligence für zugewiesene Möglichkeiten.

• Erfahrung in der nichtklinischen Entwicklung (10+ Jahre) mit bewährter Erfahrung in Due Diligence oder externer Innovation, ideal über verschiedene Geographien hinweg.

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit in funktionsübergreifenden, multikulturellen und internationalen Teams.
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und analytische Fähigkeiten.

Le directeur, Diligence raisonnable non clinique et Évaluations externes, assure le leadership scientifique en matière de diligence raisonnable non clinique à l'appui des licences, acquisitions et collaborations stratégiques des CSL. Ce rôle assure l'intégration, l'objectivité et la prise de décisions d'évaluations de la pharmacologie non clinique, du PK/PSQ et des données toxicologiques afin de cerner les risques de développement, les lacunes en matière de données et les stratégies d'atténuation et d'éclairer les décisions du portefeuille. Le titulaire agira également à titre de représentant non clinique pour certains programmes de recherche et appuiera la surveillance des stratégies et des programmes non cliniques dans tous les domaines thérapeutiques. Ce rôle relève du directeur exécutif, chef du développement non clinique. Responsabilités et responsabilités
• Dirige l'exécution opérationnelle de la diligence raisonnable non clinique pour les possibilités attribuées.
• agit en tant qu'intégrateur scientifique pratique, traduisant les commentaires d'experts en récits de risques clairs.
• Chef de file en matière de DD non clinique pour les transactions individuelles.

• Identifier les lacunes de la FIH, les risques de traduction et les limites réglementaires, avec des propositions d'atténuation claires.
• Préparer des rapports de haute qualité sur la DD, des résumés exécutifs et des tableaux de risques pour l'examen de la gouvernance.
• Agir en tant qu'interface scientifique des maladies non transmissibles avec les équipes du développement des entreprises et du domaine thérapeutique au niveau du projet.
• Contribuer à la maintenance et à l'amélioration continue des cadres et modèles de DD non cliniques.

jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Associate Director, AI & Advanced Analytics? The job is in our King of Prussia, PA, Waltham, MA, Maidenhead UK, Bern Switzerland or Melbourne Australia Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week. You will report to the Senior Director, AI/ML Advanced Analytics, Automation & Digital Agent CoE

You will support the deployment and scaling of AI/ML models, digital agents, and automation solutions across R&D. Contributes to technical delivery, stakeholder coordination, and responsible governance practices to enable innovation and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

• Support development and deployment of AI models, automation scripts, and intelligent
agents.

• Apply agentic software development approaches to drive innovation across R&D.

• Partner with R&D teams and digital leads to identify and prototype use cases aligned to
business needs.

• Contribute to MLOps processes, model documentation, and system validation
workflows.

• Help drive platform integration, compliance tracking, and continuous improvement
initiatives.

• Collaborate on internal capability building (e.g., hackathons, training) and end-user
support.

• Track success metrics such as usage, performance, and value delivered

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's or master's degree in data science, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience in AI/ML, analytics, or automation, preferably in R&D or life
sciences.

• Practical experience building or supporting machine learning pipelines or agent-based
tools.

• Familiarity with MLOps tools, low-code automation platforms, or scripting languages
(e.g., Python, R).

• Experience building and publishing solutions using agentic development approaches
and tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex).

The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $181,000-214,000 for Waltham MA only. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximum base pay that CSL expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Individual base salary for a successful candidate is determined by qualifications, skill level, experience, competencies and other relevant factors. In addition to base salary, total compensation for this role may also include incentive compensation and equity.

#LI-HYBRID

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

jobs.description:
Position Purpose: Ensure Corporate & External Affairs liaison with commercial and site leadership in Switzerland. Provide strategic guidance and direction to the affiliate and site leadership teams on government relations, policy, and advocacy, enable early identification and mitigation of policy risks, and leveraging opportunities in support of our operations and commercial priorities. Lead engagement with government in support of site operations and commercial priorities, develop a long-term external engagement plan for the company.
This role reports to:

• International Head Policy, Advocacy and Government Affairs

• Commercial Affiliate and Site Management (dotted line)

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Develop and lead execution of strategic plan to drive public affairs, executive though leadership engagement that enable the success of CSL’s operations, business and patient access to our therapies in Switzerland.

• Lead and coordinate CSL company engagement with government officials, industry associations, patient advocacy groups and other stakeholders. Represents CSL and takes leading role in key industry associations and committees. Partners with CSL functions to support external engagement priorities in Switzerland. Partners with Communications team for advancing strategic media relations in Switzerland.

• Lead the development of business-relevant policy updates to senior company leaders, in alignment with relevant affiliate functions and the CEA leadership.

• Serve on Switzerland Commercial Leadership Team, partner and pro-actively collaborate with functional leads, including Therapeutic Areas Commercial, Medical, Market Access, and Regulatory, to develop and execute joint strategies.

• Serve on Bern Site Leadership Team.] Drives strategic site engagement at political level, in partnership with leadership of the manufacturing sites and the communications team.

• Bring strategic insights to shape CEA strategy in Switzerland and International region.

• Is a key interface partner and relationship manager with patient advocacy groups, and works closely with Medical Affairs and Communications teams on patient group engagement and corporate communications strategies and programs in Switzerland.

Position Qualifications and Experience Requirements:
Education:

• Graduate/professional degree in law, public health, international relations, political sciences or similar disciplines preferred.

Experience in Switzerland:

• Minimum 8 years of experience in healthcare policy/public affairs, access or comparable fields

• Experience designing and leading efforts to build company profile and impact with important healthcare public affairs stakeholders at the national and local levels

• Experience collaborating with colleagues at multiple levels of the organization (matrix) to align on and execute shared goals

• Strong understanding of the workings of major government/public authorities and healthcare industry associations

• Experience partnering with patient groups to advance shared policy goals

• Strong, proved network of relationships with government officials, policy makers, industry, patient advocacy, and other stakeholders that are influential in policy formulation

• Experience in biologics, plasma, or pharma products industries preferred

• Experience in media relations or integrated communications campaigns preferred

Competencies :

• Strong analytical skills, including ability to spot risks and draw connections between complex policy issues and business impact

• Strong communications skills, including ability to communicate accurate, succinct descriptions of policy/political developments to senior business and international leaders

• Results oriented & growth mindset

• Strong team player skills and ability to work in a matrix organ

jobs.title: Global Product Leader
jobs.description:
Global Product Leader
Some roles exist to manage processes. This one exists to make consequential decisions about medicines that matter to patients with serious diseases — and to ensure those decisions are made well, at pace, and with the full weight of evidence behind them.
CSL Behring is seeking a Global Product Leader (GPL) to take end-to-end ownership of a late-stage development asset, from late research transition through development, commercialization, and lifecycle management. The accountability is real: for strategy, for delivery, and for the value the asset creates across its lifetime.

The Role
As GPL, you will sit on the Therapeutic Area Leadership Team and represent the asset at CSL's most senior governance forums. You will lead a global, cross-functional Product Strategy Team — bringing together clinical, regulatory, commercial, manufacturing, and scientific expertise into a coherent, executable plan. You will own the asset strategy, drive it through governance with clear, well-framed recommendations, and ensure the organization moves decisively when decisions are needed.
The scope is broad. You will integrate competitive intelligence, payer dynamics, patient insights, and evolving clinical data into strategic trade-offs. You will lead lifecycle value creation — label expansions, new indications, geographic reach. You will represent CSL externally, including in due diligence and partnership contexts. Your thinking will be tested by people who know the science, the market, and the economics — and it needs to hold up.
Leadership here means influence rather than line authority: building alignment across functions and sustaining it through organizational complexity, competing priorities, and the inevitable turbulence of long development programs.

What You'll Be Responsible For
You will own the Product Strategy Plan and keep it current as data and conditions evolve — balancing honest advocacy for the asset with the objectivity to adjust when the evidence calls for it. You will prepare governance bodies to make good decisions by giving them well-structured options, clear trade-offs, and a recommendation you're willing to defend. You will anticipate risks and surface them early, rather than letting surprises reach the wrong moment.
You will shape a team culture where problems are raised before they escalate, accountability is shared, and the work moves with both strategic clarity and execution discipline. You will contribute to building the next generation of product leaders at CSL and to the continued development of the GPL function itself.

What We're Looking For
You likely have 12 or more years in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical development, with experience that spans the value chain — from late research or early clinical stages through to commercialization or market access. You have owned an asset in a meaningful sense: responsible for its direction and outcomes, not just its coordination.
You can hold a position under pressure and revise it when the data warrant. You can read a complex situation — scientific, organizational, commercial — and turn it into a clear narrative and a plan that people will follow.
An advanced degree is required; a PhD, MD, PharmD, or MBA is preferred. Therapeutic area expertise in CSL Behring's portfolio is an advantage, though not a prerequisite for the right candidate.

Working Arrangements
Hybrid, 3 days a week onsite, plus business travel

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

We are currently looking for an Associate Director, Non-Clinical Pharmacology - CVR to join our team in Schlieren, Zurich.

Key Tasks

• Design and implement study protocols for nonclinical pharmacology studies with a particular focus on PK/PD and efficacy studies in translational models of disease in Cardiovascular and Renal indications

• Work closely with PK, Toxicology and Translational Science to integrate nonclinical pharmacology plans into a broader drug discovery plan to support effective project stage transitions and decision making

• Collaborate with internal teams, academic collaborators or CROs to ensure high-quality, timely execution of pharmacology studies and organizational alignment on key Go/No Go criteria

• Engage with and manage outside vendors and partners, including guidance and review of experiments conducted by third party vendors

• Participate in project teams and provide expert input on nonclinical pharmacology strategy and execution

• Prepare study reports, presentations, and present findings to internal stakeholders and external collaborators as needed

• Contribute to regulatory documents for IND submission

• Foster a culture of scientific excellence, psychological safety, innovation, and continuous growth

Your Profile

• Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Physiology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in nonclinical pharmacology within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry with proven understanding of drug discovery and pharmaceutical development

• Expertise in in vivo pharmacology, disease models, and translational science for the relevant TA (Cardiovascular and/or Renal Disease Biology).

• Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities is highly desirable Proven ability to work in project teams and to manage multiple projects and timelines

Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL is an Equal Opp

Descrizione L'organizzazione R&D di CSL sta accelerando l'innovazione per fornire un maggiore impatto per i pazienti. Con una struttura guidata dal progetto e un focus sulla collaborazione, stiamo costruendo un team pronto per il futuro che prospera negli ecosistemi biotech dinamici. Unirsi a CSL significa ora essere parte di un team agile impegnato a sviluppare terapie che fanno una differenza significativa in tutto il mondo. Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di un direttore associato, Farmacologia non clinica - CVR per unirsi al nostro team a Schlieren, Zurigo. --- Mansioni - Progettare e implementare protocolli di studio per studi di farmacologia non clinici con particolare attenzione a PK/PD e studi di efficacia nei modelli traduttivi di malattia nelle indicazioni cardiovascolari e renali - Lavorare a stretto contatto con PK, Tossicologia e Scienza Traduttiva per integrare i piani di farmacologia nonclinica in un più ampio piano di scoperta della droga per sostenere transizioni di fase di progetto efficaci e processi decisionali - Collaborare con team interni, collaboratori accademici o CRO per garantire l'esecuzione tempestiva di studi di farmacologia e l'allineamento organizzativo su criteri chiave Go/No Go - Coinvolgere e gestire fornitori e partner esterni, tra cui la guida e la revisione di esperimenti condotti da fornitori terzi - Partecipare a team di progetto e fornire un contributo esperto sulla strategia e l'esecuzione nonclinica della farmacologia - Preparare rapporti di studio, presentazioni e presentare i risultati agli stakeholder interni e ai collaboratori esterni secondo le necessità - Contribuire ai documenti regolamentari per la presentazione IND - Promuovere una cultura di eccellenza scientifica, sicurezza psicologica, innovazione e crescita continua ---
• Requisiti - Ph.D. in Farmacologia, Fisiologia, Scienze Biomedicali, o un campo correlato - 5+ anni di esperienza nella farmacologia nonclinica nell'industria farmaceutica o biotecnologica con una comprovata comprensione della scoperta della droga e dello sviluppo farmaceutico - Competenza in farmacologia in vivo, modelli di malattia e scienze traduttive per il TA rilevante (Cardiovascolare e/o Malattia Renale Biologia) - L'esperienza in più aree terapeutiche e modalità è altamente auspicabile - Prove capacità di lavorare in team di progetto e di gestire più progetti e tempi --- Cosa? CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena. CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi. Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Vifor visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma all'indirizzo https://www.cslplasma.com/. Benefici Per maggiori informazioni sui beneficiari CSL visita Come CSL supporta il tuo benessere | CSL. Inclusione e Appartenenza A CSL, Inclusione e Belonging è al centro della nostra missione e chi siamo. Esso alimenta la nostra innovazione giorno in e giorno fuori. Festeggiando le nostre differenze e creando una cultura della curiosità e dell'empatia, siamo in grado di comprendere meglio e connetterci con i nostri pazienti e donatori, promuovere forti relazioni con i nostri stakeholder, e sostenere una forza lavoro diversificata che muoverà la nostra azienda e l'industria nel futuro. The Opportunity:

• The Global Reliability Engineering Lead provides enterprise leadership for asset reliability, maintenance excellence, and engineering rigor across all CSL Behring manufacturing sites.

• This role drives global standardization of reliability methodologies, ensures consistency in maintenance work processes, and strengthens long-term asset performance.

• The position serves as a strategic partner to site reliability teams and centers of excellence by setting global expectations, supporting technical capability development, and promoting practices that improve equipment performance, reduce risk, and safeguard business continuity.

• All responsibilities must be executed in alignment with CSL’s patient-focused mission and Core Values, and with a high level of integrity, collaboration, and cultural awareness.

The Role:

• Global Reliability Framework and Direction -

• Establish and maintain the global reliability strategy that supports asset lifecycle performance, operational continuity, and alignment with CSL engineering standards.

• Develop standardized reliability frameworks, tools, and metrics that strengthen work process discipline across all manufacturing sites.

• Conduct global assessments to identify gaps, benchmark best practices, and ensure consistent application of reliability fundamentals.

• Monitor global KPIs related to asset reliability, maintenance efficiency, and operational risk, and communicate insights to site and regional leadership.

• Ensure adherence to regulatory expectations and internal quality requirements across all reliability-related activities.

• Technical Leadership and Engineering Excellence-

• Provide expert technical guidance for complex equipment challenges and high-risk investigations across the global network.

• Facilitate and mentor site teams in methods such as RCM, FMEA, RCA, predictive diagnostics, and other reliability engineering principles.

• Support the evaluation of new technologies, materials, and design approaches to ensure maintainability, reliability, and cost effectiveness.

• Review equipment installation, commissioning, and qualification plans to ensure alignment with asset lifecycle requirements.

• Drive improvement in preventive and predictive maintenance programs, including the use of advanced diagnostic tools.

• Global Collaboration and Capability Building-

• Partner with site engineering, maintenance, operations, quality, EHS, and OpEx teams to build shared understanding of reliability objectives and to strengthen network alignment.

• Lead global workshops, training programs, and knowledge sharing forums that build technical capability in reliability engineering.

• Support the development of global learning materials for maintenance engineering functions and ensure consistent training across sites.

• Promote open communication, cross-functional engagement, and collaborative problem-solving across regional and global teams.

• Demonstrate flexibility in work hours to support global stakeholders in different time zones.

• People and Culture Expectations -

• Reinforce CSL’s Core Values of Patient Focus, Innovation, Integrity, Collaboration, and Superior Performance in all interactions.

• Serve as a cultural ambassador who models professionalism, ethical behavior, sound judgment, and inclusive collaboration.

• Support global safety expectations by consistently using required PPE when on site and complying with occupational health and safety practices.

• Other Responsibilities-

• Foster a respectful and positive environment where continuous improvement, accountability, and learning are encouraged.

• Provide technical input during capital project reviews related to maintainability, reliability risk, and long term asset performance.

• Participate in audits, inspections, and program reviews to ensure compliance and drive continuous improvement.

• Contribute to strategic initiatives and business priorities led by global engineering or Ka

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'opportunità: - Il Global Reliability Engineering Lead fornisce la leadership aziendale per l'affidabilità, l'eccellenza della manutenzione e il rigore ingegneristico in tutti i siti di produzione CSL Behring. - Questo ruolo guida la standardizzazione globale delle metodologie di affidabilità, assicura la coerenza nei processi di manutenzione e rafforza le prestazioni di asset a lungo termine. - La posizione funge da partner strategico per team di affidabilità del sito e centri di eccellenza impostando aspettative globali, supportando lo sviluppo delle capacità tecniche e promuovendo pratiche che migliorano le prestazioni delle attrezzature, riducono il rischio e salvaguardano la continuità aziendale. - Tutte le responsabilità devono essere eseguite in allineamento con la missione focalizzata sul paziente e i valori fondamentali della CSL, e con un alto livello di integrità, collaborazione e consapevolezza culturale. Il ruolo: - Global Reliability Framework and Direction - - Stabilire e mantenere la strategia di affidabilità globale che supporta le prestazioni del ciclo di vita degli asset, la continuità operativa e l'allineamento con gli standard di ingegneria CSL. - Sviluppare framework, strumenti e metriche di affidabilità standardizzati che rafforzano la disciplina del processo di lavoro in tutti i siti di produzione. - Condurre valutazioni globali per identificare lacune, best practice di benchmark e garantire l'applicazione coerente dei fondamentali di affidabilità. - Monitorare i KPI globali relativi all'affidabilità degli asset, all'efficienza di manutenzione e al rischio operativo, e comunicare intuizioni alla leadership del sito e regionale. - Assicurare l'adesione alle aspettative normative e ai requisiti di qualità interna in tutte le attività correlate all'affidabilità. - Leadership tecnica e ingegneria eccellenza- - Fornire una guida tecnica esperta per complesse sfide e indagini ad alto rischio in tutta la rete globale. - Facilitate e tutor team di siti in metodi come RCM, FMEA, RCA, diagnostica predittiva e altri principi di ingegneria di affidabilità. - Supporta la valutazione di nuove tecnologie, materiali e approcci di progettazione per garantire la manutenbilità, l'affidabilità e l'efficacia dei costi. - Verificare l'installazione, la messa in servizio e i piani di qualificazione per garantire l'allineamento con i requisiti del ciclo di vita degli asset. - Miglioramento dell'azionamento nei programmi di manutenzione preventiva e predittiva, compreso l'uso di strumenti diagnostici avanzati. - Global Collaboration and Capability Building- - Partner con i team di progettazione, manutenzione, operazioni, qualità, EHS e OpEx per la comprensione condivisa degli obiettivi di affidabilità e per rafforzare l'allineamento della rete. - Condurre workshop globali, programmi di formazione e forum di condivisione delle conoscenze che costruiscono capacità tecniche nell'ingegneria dell'affidabilità. - Sostenere lo sviluppo di materiali di apprendimento globali per le funzioni di ingegneria della manutenzione e garantire una formazione coerente tra i siti. - Promuovere la comunicazione aperta, l'impegno interfunzionale e la risoluzione dei problemi collaborativi tra team regionali e globali. - Dimostrare flessibilità nelle ore di lavoro per sostenere gli stakeholder globali in diverse fusi orari. - Persone e culture - - Rinforzare i valori fondamentali della CSL del focus paziente, innovazione, integrità, collaborazione e prestazioni superiori in tutte le interazioni. - Servire come ambasciatore culturale che modella professionalità, comportamento etico, giudizio sonoro e collaborazione inclusiva. - Sostenere le aspettative di sicurezza globali utilizzando costantemente PPE richiesto quando sul posto e rispettare le pratiche di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro. - Altre responsabilità - Promuovere un ambiente rispettoso e positivo in cui vengono incoraggiati continui miglioramenti, responsabilità e apprendimento. - Fornire input tecnici durante le recensioni dei progetti di capitale relativi a manutenbilità, rischio di affidabilità e prestazioni di asset a lungo termine. - Partecipare a audit, ispezioni e recensioni di programmi per garantire la conformità e guidare il miglioramento continuo. - Contribuire a iniziative strategiche e priorità di business guidate dall'ingegneria globale o da Ka

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Die Gelegenheit: - Der Global Reliability Engineering Lead bietet Unternehmensführung für Asset-Verlässlichkeit, Maintenance Excellence und Engineering Rigor in allen CSL Behring Fertigungsstandorten. - Diese Rolle treibt die globale Standardisierung von Zuverlässigkeitsmethoden an, sorgt für Konsistenz bei Wartungsarbeiten und stärkt die langfristige Asset-Performance. - Die Position dient als strategischer Partner, um Zuverlässigkeitsteams und Exzellenzzentren zu bieten, indem sie globale Erwartungen festlegt, technische Fähigkeiten entwickelt und Praktiken fördert, die die Leistung der Geräte verbessern, das Risiko reduzieren und die Kontinuität der Unternehmen sichern. - Alle Verantwortlichkeiten müssen im Einklang mit der patientenorientierten Mission und den Kernwerten der CSL und mit einem hohen Maß an Integrität, Zusammenarbeit und kulturellem Bewusstsein ausgeführt werden. Die Rolle: - Global Reliability Framework and Direction - - Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung der globalen Zuverlässigkeitsstrategie, die die Leistung des Asset Lifecycle, die operative Kontinuität und die Ausrichtung auf die CSL-Engineering-Standards unterstützt. - Entwicklung standardisierter Zuverlässigkeitsrahmen, Werkzeuge und Metriken, die die Arbeitsprozessdisziplin auf allen Fertigungsstandorten stärken. - Führen Sie globale Bewertungen durch, um Lücken zu identifizieren, Best Practices zu bewerten und eine konsequente Anwendung von Zuverlässigkeitsgrundsätzen zu gewährleisten. - Überwachen Sie globale KPIs im Zusammenhang mit Asset-Verlässlichkeit, Maintenance-Effizienz und operativem Risiko und kommunizieren Sie Einblicke in Standort und regionale Führung. - Sicherstellung der Einhaltung regulatorischer Erwartungen und internen Qualitätsanforderungen in allen sicherheitsrelevanten Aktivitäten. - Technische Leitung und Engineering Excellence- - Bieten Sie eine kompetente technische Anleitung für komplexe Geräteherausforderungen und Risikountersuchungen im gesamten globalen Netzwerk. - Facilitate und Mentor-Site-Teams in Methoden wie RCM, FMEA, RCA, Predictive Diagnostik und andere Zuverlässigkeits-Engineering-Prinzipien. - Unterstützung der Bewertung neuer Technologien, Materialien und Design-Ansätze, um die Aufrechterhaltungsfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz zu gewährleisten. - Prüfen Sie die Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Qualifizierungspläne, um die Anpassung an die
• Anforderungen des Anlagelebenszyklus zu gewährleisten. - Verbesserung der vorbeugenden und vorausschauenden Wartungsprogramme, einschließlich der Verwendung fortschrittlicher Diagnosewerkzeuge. - Global Collaboration and Capability Building- - Partner mit Standort-Engineering, Wartung, Betrieb, Qualität, EHS und OpEx-Teams, um das gemeinsame Verständnis von Zuverlässigkeitszielen aufzubauen und die Netzwerkausrichtung zu stärken. - Führen Sie globale Workshops, Schulungsprogramme und Wissensaustauschforen, die technische Fähigkeiten in der Zuverlässigkeitstechnik aufbauen. - Unterstützung der Entwicklung globaler Lernmaterialien für Instandhaltungs-Engineering-Funktionen und sorgen für eine konsequente Schulung über Standorte. - Förderung der offenen Kommunikation, des funktionsübergreifenden Engagements und der kollaborativen Problemlösung zwischen regionalen und globalen Teams. - Die Flexibilität in den Arbeitsstunden zur Unterstützung globaler Stakeholder in unterschiedlichen Zeitzonen zeigen. - Menschen und Kultur Erwartungen - - Verstärken Sie die Kernwerte von Patientenfokus, Innovation, Integrität, Zusammenarbeit und Überlegenheit in allen Interaktionen. - Serve als Kulturbotschafter, der Professionalität, ethisches Verhalten, fundiertes Urteil und integrative Zusammenarbeit modelliert. - Unterstützung der globalen Sicherheitserwartungen durch konsequente Nutzung der erforderlichen PPE, wenn vor Ort und nach den Arbeitsschutz- und Sicherheitspraktiken. - Sonstige
• Aufgaben - Eine respektvolle und positive Umgebung, in der kontinuierliche Verbesserung, Rechenschaftspflicht und Lernen gefördert werden. - Bereitstellung technischer Input während der Kapital-Projekt-Bewertungen im Zusammenhang mit Aufrechterhaltungsfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeitsrisiko und langfristiger Vermögensleistung. - Nehmen Sie an Audits, Inspektionen und Programmüberprüfungen teil, um die Einhaltung zu gewährleisten und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu erreichen. - Beitrag zu strategischen Initiativen und Unternehmensprioritäten unter der Leitung von Global Engineering oder Ka
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione La possibilité : - Le Global Reliability Engineering Lead assure la direction de l'entreprise pour la fiabilité des actifs, l'excellence de maintenance et la rigueur technique sur tous les sites de fabrication CSL Behring. - Ce rôle stimule la normalisation mondiale des méthodes de fiabilité, assure la cohérence des processus de maintenance et renforce la performance des actifs à long terme. - Le poste sert de partenaire stratégique aux équipes de fiabilité du site et aux centres d'excellence en établissant des attentes mondiales, en appuyant le développement des capacités techniques et en favorisant des pratiques qui améliorent la performance des équipements, réduisent les risques et garantissent la continuité des activités. - Toutes les responsabilités doivent être exécutées en accord avec la mission axée sur le patient et les valeurs fondamentales du CSL, et avec un haut niveau d'intégrité, de collaboration et de sensibilisation culturelle. Le rôle : - Cadre et orientation de fiabilité mondiale - - Établir et maintenir la stratégie de fiabilité globale qui appuie la performance du cycle de vie des actifs, la continuité opérationnelle et l'alignement sur les normes d'ingénierie CSL. - Élaborer des cadres de fiabilité, des outils et des mesures normalisés qui renforcent la discipline des processus de travail dans tous les sites de fabrication. - Effectuer des évaluations globales afin d'identifier les lacunes, de comparer les meilleures pratiques et d'assurer une application cohérente des principes de fiabilité. - Surveiller les ICR mondiaux liés à la fiabilité des actifs, à l'efficacité de la maintenance et aux risques opérationnels, et communiquer des renseignements au leadership local et régional. - Assurer le respect des attentes réglementaires et des exigences internes en matière de qualité pour toutes les activités liées à la fiabilité. - Leadership technique et excellence en génie - Fournir des conseils techniques spécialisés pour les problèmes complexes d'équipement et les enquêtes à haut risque dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial. - Faciliter et encadrer les équipes de site dans des méthodes telles que RCM, FMEA, RCA, diagnostics prédictifs et autres principes d'ingénierie de la fiabilité. - Appuyer l'évaluation des nouvelles technologies, des nouveaux matériaux et des approches de conception pour assurer la maintenance, la fiabilité et la rentabilité. - Examiner les plans d'installation, de mise en service et de qualification de l'équipement afin d'assurer l'alignement sur les exigences du cycle de vie des biens. - Favoriser l'amélioration des programmes de maintenance préventive et prédictive, y compris l'utilisation d'outils de diagnostic avancés. - Collaboration mondiale et renforcement des capacités - S'associer à des équipes d'ingénierie, de maintenance, d'exploitation, de qualité, d'EHS et d'OpEx pour développer une compréhension commune des objectifs de fiabilité et renforcer l'alignement du réseau. - Diriger des ateliers mondiaux, des programmes de formation et des forums de partage des connaissances qui renforcent les capacités techniques en ingénierie de la fiabilité. - Appuyer la mise au point de matériel d'apprentissage mondial pour les fonctions d'ingénierie de la maintenance et assurer une formation cohérente entre les sites. - Promouvoir la communication ouverte, l'engagement interfonctionnel et la résolution de problèmes en collaboration entre les équipes régionales et mondiales. - Faire preuve de souplesse dans les heures de travail pour aider les acteurs mondiaux dans différents fuseaux horaires. - Les attentes des gens et de la culture - - Renforcer les valeurs fondamentales de la focalisation des patients, de l'innovation, de l'intégrité, de la collaboration et du rendement supérieur dans toutes les interactions. - Servir d'ambassadeur culturel qui modélise le professionnalisme, le comportement éthique, le jugement sain et la collaboration inclusive. - Soutenir les attentes mondiales en matière de sécurité en utilisant systématiquement les EPI requis sur place et en respectant les pratiques de santé et de sécurité au travail. - Autres responsabilités - Favoriser un environnement respectueux et positif où l'on encourage l'amélioration continue, la responsabilisation et l'apprentissage. - Fournir des données techniques lors de l'examen des projets d'immobilisations concernant la maintenance, le risque de fiabilité et le rendement à long terme des actifs. - Participer aux vérifications, aux inspections et aux examens des programmes pour assurer la conformité et favoriser l'amélioration continue. - Contribuer aux initiatives stratégiques et aux priorités d'affaires menées par l'ingénierie mondiale ou Ka

jobs.title: GRA CMC Specialist
jobs.description:
Position Purpose

Partnering closely with global and regional Global Regulatory Affairs colleagues, as well as Global Operations stakeholders, to address regulatory strategy challenges and deliver innovative, timely regulatory CMC solutions that meet evolving regulatory and compliance requirements.

Supporting digital innovation, enabling capital project initiatives, and managing strategic external partnerships by coordinating and aligning regulatory CMC strategies and activities across the enterprise.

Ensuring operational alignment of Global Regulatory Affairs CMC activities and processes with R&D Global Regulatory Affairs and within Global Operations business needs.

This role promotes strong cross-functional collaboration and effective communication across Global Operations, R&D, Global Regulatory Affairs, and other relevant CSL business functions to drive alignment and support CSL’s strategic business objectives.

Main 
• Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Develop global regulatory CMC strategies for enterprise-wide CAPEX and compliance projects through collaboration with functional leaders in Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Quality, Global Operations, and other business functions.

Assess and facilitate the use of digital innovation for Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, including AI/ML applications that manage or support regulatory submission, notification, assessment and intelligence activities. Collaborate with Procurement, IT, external vendors, and R&D Global Regulatory Affairs to implement next-generation solutions that enhance the generation of regulatory strategies and execution of regulatory operations. Define and monitor KPIs to measure impact of digital initiatives on operational efficiency indicators.

Manage relationships with outsourcing vendors to support global regulatory CMC activities. Serve as contact for external partners, coordinating deliverables, timelines, and compliance across multiple projects and geographies. Monitor performance, quality, KPIs, and regulatory readiness of outsourced operations, driving continuous improvement and risk mitigation strategies.

Monitor, interpret, and communicate evolving global CMC regulations (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, etc.). Ensure timely dissemination of regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders and integration into strategic planning.

Coordinate key regulatory CMC activities for the Global Regulatory Affairs CMC organization, including change control, due diligence (for potential acquisitions, licensing, and partnerships), template management for quality CTD sections, deviation support, inspection support, and others.

Support the collaboration with CSL’s Corporate & External Affairs organization to support legislative and statutory initiatives to allow CSL to take an active leadership role in shaping policy and regulatory frameworks that impact the development, registration, and life-cycle management of plasma-derived therapies.

Support the development of strategic and tactical plans for Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, advising senior leadership on regulatory requirements and their implications for project timelines, compliance, and business strategy. Contribute to the evaluation of new business opportunities in collaboration with development teams.

Ensure regulatory policies and procedures are developed and implemented in accordance with applicable international standards and requirements.

Support the the creation and execution of regulatory policies, processes, and SOPs that meet global regulatory requirements while driving operational efficiency and effectiveness across Global Operations and its stakeholder network.

Support the execution of the outsourcing of regulatory activities, including performance monitoring and quality assurance, to ensure timely and compliant delivery of services aligned with business and regulatory requirements.

Position 
• Qualifications and Experience 
• Requirements

Education & Experience

A bachel

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggetto CMC - Network Strategy & Operation è responsabile per: Collaborando a stretto contatto con i colleghi globali e regionali di regolamentazione globale, nonché con le parti interessate di Global Operations, per affrontare le sfide della strategia di regolamentazione e fornire soluzioni CMC normative innovative e tempestive che soddisfano i requisiti di regolamentazione e conformità in evoluzione. Sostenere l'innovazione digitale, abilitare iniziative di progetto di capitale e gestire partnership esterne strategiche coordinando e allineando le strategie e le attività regolamentari CMC in tutta l'azienda. Garantire l'allineamento operativo delle attività e dei processi di Global Regulatory Affairs CMC con R&D Global Regulatory Affairs e all'interno delle esigenze aziendali di Global Operations. Questo ruolo promuove una forte collaborazione interfunzionale e una comunicazione efficace attraverso Global Operations, R&D, Global Regulatory Affairs e altre funzioni aziendali CSL rilevanti per guidare l'allineamento e sostenere gli obiettivi strategici aziendali della CSL. Principali
• Responsabilità e responsabilità Sviluppare strategie CMC di regolamentazione globale per i progetti di conformità a livello aziendale e CAPEX attraverso la collaborazione con leader funzionali in Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Quality, Global Operations e altre funzioni aziendali. Valuta e facilita l'uso dell'innovazione digitale per Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, comprese le applicazioni AI/ML che gestiscono o supportano le attività di presentazione, notifica, valutazione e intelligence. Collabora con Procurement, IT, fornitori esterni e R&D Global Regulatory Affairs per implementare soluzioni di nuova generazione che migliorano la generazione di strategie normative e l'esecuzione delle operazioni di regolazione. Definire e monitorare i KPI per misurare l'impatto delle iniziative digitali sugli indicatori di efficienza operativa. Gestisci i rapporti con i fornitori di outsourcing per supportare le attività CMC normative globali. Servire come contatto per i partner esterni, coordinare i responsabili, le linee temporali e la conformità tra più progetti e geografie. Monitorare le prestazioni, la qualità, i KPI e la disponibilità normativa di operazioni outsourced, guidando strategie di miglioramento continuo e mitigazione dei rischi. Monitorare, interpretare e comunicare le normative CMC globali in evoluzione (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, ecc.). Assicurare la diffusione tempestiva dell'intelligenza normativa agli stakeholder interni e l'integrazione nella pianificazione strategica. Coordinare le attività CMC di regolamentazione chiave per l'organizzazione Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, tra cui il controllo dei cambiamenti, due diligence (per potenziali acquisizioni, licenze e partenariati), la gestione dei modelli per le sezioni CTD di qualità, il supporto di deviazione, il supporto di ispezione e altri. Sostenere la collaborazione con l’organizzazione Corporate & External Affairs di CSL per sostenere iniziative legislative e statutarie per consentire alla CSL di assumere un ruolo di leadership attivo nella definizione di politiche e quadri normativi che influiscono sullo sviluppo, la registrazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita delle terapie basate sul plasma. Sostenere lo sviluppo di piani strategici e tattici per Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, consigliando la leadership senior sui requisiti normativi e le loro implicazioni per i tempi di progetto, la conformità e la strategia aziendale. Contribuisci alla valutazione di nuove opportunità di business in collaborazione con i team di sviluppo. Assicurarsi che le politiche e le procedure di regolamentazione siano sviluppate e implementate in conformità con le norme e i requisiti internazionali applicabili. Sostenere la creazione e l'esecuzione di politiche, processi e SOP normativi globali che soddisfano i requisiti normativi globali, guidando l'efficienza operativa e l'efficacia su Global Operations e sulla sua rete di stakeholder. Sostenere l'esecuzione dell'outsourcing delle attività regolamentari, compreso il monitoraggio delle prestazioni e la garanzia della qualità, per garantire la consegna tempestiva e conforme dei servizi allineati con le esigenze aziendali e regolamentari

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Global Labeling Strategy
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

• The Sr. Director, Head of Global Labeling Strategy leads the Global Labeling strategy function within Global Labeling, Advertising & Promotion and has overall responsibility for the worldwide labeling strategy portfolio within CSL.

• In this leadership position, the Head of Global Labeling Strategy provides labeling guidance / perspective to respective governance bodies, advocates for CSL positions within the Development Labeling Strategy.

• Coaches/mentors Global Labeling Sr. Strategists in strategic thinking, technical and leadership attributes. As the business owner for the labeling strategy review/approval process, the Head of Global Labeling Strategy ensures the optimal development / implementation of processes and supports revisions to these processes to enable continuous improvement.

• Due to the global nature of the position, the Head of Global Labeling Strategy engages cross-functionally with key stakeholders in Global Regulatory Affairs and Safety, Clinical Research, Commercial Development, Medical Affairs and Market Access to ensure business critical objectives are met and scientific, regulatory compliant labeling is provided to Health Care Professionals.

The Role:

• Works closely with the TA Heads, GRA GRS to maintain an effective, globally-minded, Global Regulatory Affairs and Safety organization that is focused on utilizing creative problem-solving skills, can clearly articulate the science / regulatory perspective to stakeholders, and contributes to the overall TA Strategy for each TA.

• Establishes a high performing, global culture and organizational model that facilitates the creation and maintenance of scientifically-sound, regulatory-compliant core and local labeling for CSL’s product portfolio.

• Manages a team of global labeling strategy professionals at CSL facilities, such as in the USA, Switzerland and Australia and mentors the department in CSL's Leadership behaviors and the “CSL Way.”

• Develops global labeling strategies to enable business objectives while optimizing product benefit/risk information for users and prescribers.

• Contributes and directs strategic initiatives targeting business, regulatory requirements and clinical needs related to product labeling.

• Provides expert input regarding labeling/labeling processes with local affiliates and third party distributors.

• Manages the Global Labeling Committee for the product portfolio.

• Coordinates activities including participation in internal and external labeling-related audits, ensuring labeling adheres to company SOPs and regulatory requirements.

• Represents CSL at industry associations, conferences and health authorities to promote the CSL strategic labeling perspective. Utilizing this network, brings 'best in class' labeling strategy approaches and regulatory intelligence to CSL and is abreast of current global labeling trends.

• As needed, represents Global Labeling at the Global Safety Committee (GSC).

• Ensures processes supporting generation and modification of Development Company Core Data Sheets (dCCDS) and Company Core Data Sheets (CCDS) enable timely communication and roll-out of information about changes to core product labels, in particular changes related to safety information.

Skills & Experience:

• At least 10 years of regulatory experience, with focus on global labeling strategy, and previous managerial experience (7+ years). Overall pharmaceutical /industry experience should exceed 15 years.

• Broad knowledge of and experience with regulatory product labeling requirements and risk minimization

• Experience working in a complex and matrix environment is required

• Demonstrated experience in working with multiple stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to lead, influence and motivate a cross-cultural team

• Able to think strategically and develop innovative global labeling strategies

• Leadership ability with demonstrated problem solving and decision making skills

• Strong team p

descriptionByLocale.it:
Opportunità:
• Il Direttore Sr., Responsabile della Strategia Globale di Etichettatura conduce la funzione di strategia Global Labeling all'interno di Global Labeling, Advertising & Promotion e ha la responsabilità generale per il portafoglio di strategia di etichettatura in tutto il mondo all'interno di CSL.
• In questa posizione di leadership, il capo della strategia di etichettatura globale fornisce l'etichettatura guida / prospettiva ai rispettivi enti di governance, i sostenitori delle posizioni CSL all'interno della strategia di etichettatura di sviluppo.
• Coaches/mentors Global Labeling Sr. Strateghi in termini di pensiero strategico, tecnico e di leadership. In qualità di titolare del business per il processo di valutazione/approvazione della strategia di etichettatura, il Head of Global Labeling Strategy garantisce lo sviluppo ottimale / implementazione dei processi e supporta le revisioni di questi processi per consentire il miglioramento continuo.
• A causa della natura globale della posizione, il responsabile della strategia di etichettatura globale si impegna trasversalmente con gli stakeholder chiave in affari normativi globali e sicurezza, ricerca clinica, sviluppo commerciale, affari medici e accesso al mercato per garantire obiettivi critici aziendali sono soddisfatti e l'etichettatura conforme alle normative è fornita ai professionisti della sanità. Il ruolo:
• Funziona a stretto contatto con i TA Heads, GRA GRS per mantenere un’organizzazione efficace, a livello globale, di regolamentazione globale e di sicurezza che si concentra sull’utilizzo di competenze creative di problem solving, può chiaramente articolare la prospettiva scientifica / regolamentare per gli stakeholder, e contribuisce alla strategia globale TA per ogni TA.
• Stabilisce un modello di cultura e organizzazione high performante e globale che facilita la creazione e il mantenimento del core normativo del portafoglio scientifico-comple.
• Gestisce un team di professionisti della strategia di etichettatura globale presso strutture CSL, come negli Stati Uniti, in Svizzera e in Australia e mentori il dipartimento nei comportamenti di Leadership della CSL e la “CSL Way”.
• Sviluppa strategie di etichettatura globale per consentire obiettivi aziendali, ottimizzando le informazioni sui benefici/rischio dei prodotti per gli utenti e i prescrittori.
• Contribuisce e dirige iniziative strategiche finalizzate al business, ai requisiti normativi e alle esigenze cliniche relative all'etichettatura dei prodotti.
• Fornisce un input esperto per i processi di etichettatura/etichettatura con affiliati locali e distributori di terze parti.
• gestisce il Global Labeling Committee per il portafoglio prodotti.
• Coordina le attività tra cui la partecipazione a audit relativi all'etichettatura interna ed esterna, assicurando che l'etichettatura aderisca alle SOP aziendali e ai requisiti normativi.
• Rappresenta la CSL presso associazioni di settore, conferenze e autorità sanitarie per promuovere la prospettiva di etichettatura strategica CSL. Utilizzando questa rete, porta 'migliore in classe' etichettando approcci di strategia e l'intelligenza di regolamentazione a CSL ed è al di là delle attuali tendenze di etichettatura globale.
• Come necessario, rappresenta Global Labeling presso il Global Safety Committee (GSC).
• Assicura i processi di supporto alla generazione e alla modifica delle Schede Dati Core della Società di Sviluppo (dCCDS) e delle Schede Dati Core aziendali (CCDS) consentono la comunicazione tempestiva e la diffusione di informazioni sulle modifiche alle etichette dei prodotti principali, in particolare sulle modifiche relative alle informazioni di sicurezza. Competenze & Esperienza:
• Almeno 10 anni di esperienza regolamentare, con particolare attenzione alla strategia di etichettatura globale e alla precedente esperienza manageriale (7+ anni). Nel complesso l'esperienza farmaceutica / industria dovrebbe superare i 15 anni.
• Ampia conoscenza e esperienza con i requisiti di etichettatura dei prodotti normativi e la riduzione dei rischi
• L'esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente complesso e matrice è necessaria
• Esperienza dimostrata nel lavorare con più stakeholder.
• Capacità dimostrata di guidare, influenzare e motivare un team interculturale
• In grado di pensare strategicamente e sviluppare strategie innovative di etichettatura globale
• Capacità di Leadership con capacità di problem solving e decision making dimostrate

• Le directeur principal, responsable de la stratégie mondiale d'étiquetage, dirige la fonction de stratégie mondiale d'étiquetage au sein de Global Labeling, Advertising & Promotion et assume la responsabilité générale du portefeuille de stratégie mondiale d'étiquetage au sein de CSL.
• Dans ce poste de direction, le responsable de la stratégie mondiale d'étiquetage fournit des conseils et des perspectives en matière d'étiquetage aux organes de gouvernance respectifs, et défend les postes de CSL dans le cadre de la stratégie d'étiquetage du développement.
• Coachs/mentors Global Labeling Sr. Strategists dans la pensée stratégique, les attributs techniques et de leadership. En tant que propriétaire commercial du processus d'examen et d'approbation de la stratégie d'étiquetage, le responsable de la stratégie d'étiquetage mondial assure le développement et la mise en oeuvre optimaux des processus et soutient les révisions de ces processus pour permettre une amélioration continue.
• En raison de la nature mondiale du poste, le responsable de la Stratégie mondiale d'étiquetage s'engage de manière interfonctionnelle auprès des principaux intervenants dans les domaines de la réglementation mondiale et de la sécurité, de la recherche clinique, du développement commercial, des affaires médicales et de l'accès au marché afin de s'assurer que les objectifs essentiels des entreprises sont atteints et que l'étiquetage scientifique et réglementaire est fourni aux professionnels de la santé. Le rôle :
• Collabore étroitement avec les chefs de l'AT, GRA GRS, afin de maintenir une organisation efficace, soucieuse de la réglementation mondiale et de la sécurité, axée sur l'utilisation de compétences créatives en résolution de problèmes, peut clairement exprimer la perspective scientifique et réglementaire aux parties prenantes et contribuer à la stratégie globale de l'AT pour chaque AT.
• Établit un modèle de culture et d'organisation de haut niveau et mondial qui facilite la création et le maintien d'étiquettes de base et locales scientifiquement solides et conformes à la réglementation pour le portefeuille de produits CSL.
• Gère une équipe de professionnels de la stratégie d'étiquetage mondial dans les installations de CSL, comme aux États-Unis, en Suisse et en Australie et mentore le département dans les comportements de leadership de CSL et dans la voie de CSL.
• Élaborer des stratégies d'étiquetage à l'échelle mondiale pour atteindre des objectifs commerciaux tout en optimisant l'information sur les avantages et les risques des produits pour les utilisateurs et les prescripteurs.
• Contribue et dirige des initiatives stratégiques visant les entreprises, les exigences réglementaires et les besoins cliniques liés à l'étiquetage des produits.
• Fournit des avis d'experts sur les processus d'étiquetage et d'étiquetage auprès des sociétés affiliées locales et des distributeurs tiers.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Biostatistics
jobs.description:
The Associate Director (AD), Biostatistics, leads the full scope of statistical contribution to a clinical development program. The AD provides statistical strategies for the clinical trials and regulatory submissions, and is accountable for the statistical deliverables within the program.

1 Lead full scope of Biostatistics conduct for the responsible program within a therapeutic area. Define statistical strategy and ensure appropriate statistical methodologies applied to study design and data analysis for clinical trials and regulatory submissions
2 Influence and contribute to clinical development plans, collaborate with cross-functional team for governance reviews. Lead statistical strategy for planning and study execution (member of Study Executive Team, Clinical Development Team) and quantitative evaluation to clinical trials, regulatory submissions, and related documents.
• 3 Provide statistical thought partnership for innovative study design and clinical development plans, including Go-No Go criteria and probability of technical success calculations.
• 4 Provide for project-wide planning of analyses; quality and timely delivery of interim and final results, including integrated analyses for submissions.
• 5 Represent Biostatistics in interactions with regulatory authorities (eg, FDA, EMA, PMDA)
• 6 Be responsible for interpreting analysis results and ensuring reporting accuracy in study reports and regulatory documents.
• 7 Manage outsourcing operations or work with internal statistical programmers within the responsible program. Ensure timeliness and quality of deliverables by CRO/FSP.
• 8 Support or lead improvement initiatives within the department, organization and/or pharma industry.
9 Prepare abstracts, posters, oral presentations and written reports to effectively communicate results of clinical programs and studies to internal and external stakeholders and colleagues with varying levels of clinical research knowledge.

Qualifications
• -Education: PhD or MS in Biostatistics, Statistics or related field
• -PhD with 8 years of experience or MS with 11 years of experience in drug development
• -Experience providing statistical leadership at compound/indication level
• -Demonstrated statistical expertise and leadership in facilitating and optimizing the (pre/early/full-) clinical development strategy
• -Solid experience in applications of advanced statistical methodologies
• -Leading roles in regulatory submissions
• -Experience in interactions with major regulatory authorities preferred
• -Experience with CROs (either managing a CRO, or having worked in a CRO) or managing internal deliveries preferred
• -Track record of innovation preferred

Competencies
• -Familiarity with regulatory guidance and interactions
• -Broad knowledge of clinical development and processes
• -Ability to collaboratively work and provide leadership in matrix environment
• -Strong interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written in English)
• -Good working knowledge of SAS and/or R
• -Expertise in a range of statistical methodologies
• -Demonstrated use of innovative / creative methodology for analysis of clinical data
• -Familiarity with relevant regulatory guidance documents
• -Expertise in CDISC, statistical programming, and/or data standards

L'AD fornisce strategie statistiche per gli studi clinici e le presentazioni regolamentari, ed è responsabile per i risultati statistici all'interno del programma. 1 Piombo di portata completa di Biostatistica condurre per il programma responsabile all'interno di un'area terapeutica. Definire la strategia statistica e garantire metodologie statistiche appropriate applicate alla progettazione e all'analisi dei dati per gli studi clinici e le sottomissioni normative 2 Influenza e contribuire ai piani di sviluppo clinico, collaborare con il team interfunzionale per le recensioni di governance. Guidare la strategia statistica per la pianificazione e l'esecuzione di studi (membro del team esecutivo di studio, team di sviluppo clinico) e la valutazione quantitativa a studi clinici, presentazioni normative e documenti correlati.
• 3 Fornire un partenariato di pensiero statistico per progetti di studio innovativi e di sviluppo clinico, compresi i criteri Go-No Go e la probabilità di calcoli di successo tecnico.
• 4 Fornire una pianificazione di analisi a livello di progetto; qualità e consegna tempestiva dei risultati intermedi e finali, comprese le analisi integrate per le presentazioni.
• 5 Rappresentante Biostatistica nelle interazioni con le autorità di regolamentazione (ad esempio, FDA, EMA, PMDA)
• 6 Sii responsabile dell'interpretazione dei risultati dell'analisi e dell'accuratezza delle relazioni di studio e dei documenti normativi.
